coordinates.points: [x, y]; divide x by width and y by height to normalize

measurements.contentBounds: Half-opacity mask bounds for actors; full image bounds for opaque backgrounds and cards.
measurements.source: Decoded resized runtime pixels and SHA-256 of WebP files; original PNG provenance is recorded per asset.

anchorPolicy.ready: ground is the projected midpoint of two visually estimated boot contacts; it is not a collision or ball-contact point.
anchorPolicy.kick: ground marks the planted boot; kickContact separately marks the raised striking boot. Neither is the ball center. Do not replace either with an alpha bounding-box corner.
anchorPolicy.dive: Airborne poses intentionally have no ground anchor. Use bodyPivot for the body and groundProjection only as a low-confidence placement assumption; gloveContact and supportingGloveContact mark the two palms.
anchorPolicy.collision: Alpha bounds describe visible coverage only. Neither bounds nor the provisional anchors validate foot-ball, hand-ball, or turf contact.
anchorPolicy.mirroring: Facing describes the source image before any horizontal reflection. Reflect anchor x with width - x when drawing the image mirrored.
anchorPolicy.run: ground is a projection below the pelvis for scene placement; supportContact is a separate provisional boot reference, not a guarantee that the depicted stride touches turf.
anchorPolicy.poseChange: Pose anchors have different meanings. Changing from ready to kick or dive requires an explicit placement transition; matching the image rectangle or bottom pixel is not contact validation.

notes: All 25 supplied PNGs were decoded and visually inspected. The manifest records file measurements, not runtime compositing approval.
Actor files contain broad, low-alpha colored halos. nonzeroBounds must not define anatomical height or a foot contact.
All current actor files have alpha maxima of 254, so alpha == 255 would incorrectly find no solid body.
Card illustrations contain painted balls and players; they are card art, not layers for the live match.
Background variants have different crowd appearances; see production-notes.md before intercutting them.

Runtime WebP images are resized without cropping. Backgrounds use quality 95; actors and cards use lossless encoding after resizing. Anchors scale with image dimensions. Original PNG files are retained for editing and provenance.
